subtitles.en: There is a sense right now in markets that this is a Fed that is newly renewing their commitment to controlling inflation. Clearly yield curve flattening, clearly risk off
subtitles.zh: 目前市场感觉美联储重新承诺控制通胀。收益率曲线明显趋平，风险偏好下降。

subtitles.en: in stocks. Is this signal or is this noise? Well, there's a lot of both. This is quite the change and I think we're all trying to digest
subtitles.zh: 这是信号还是噪音？两者都有。变化很大，我们都在消化刚听到的消息。

subtitles.en: what we just heard. I think there's a real risk here. Jonathan's not on the program, so I'm going to do my best to interpretation. The first reaction is not always the right reaction.
subtitles.zh: 我认为存在真实风险。第一反应不总是正确的。

subtitles.en: I think there's a risk here of overplaying the yield curve flattening and the questioning of the long end that I'm listening to here. First of all, this is a market that is split between
subtitles.zh: 我担心过度解读收益率曲线趋平和对长端的质疑。市场在旧反应函数间分裂。

subtitles.en: the old reaction function, which really moved on the dot plot. The nine dots voting for a hike were
subtitles.zh: 旧反应函数主要受点阵图影响。支持加息的九个点远超预期，推动了市场。

subtitles.en: well in excessive expectations and that's what moved the market. But then you have Warsh basically telling you we're going to get rid of the dot plot. I mean, he got you all the way.
subtitles.zh: 但沃什暗示将取消点阵图。他几乎达到目标，但不想预判工作组结果。

subtitles.en: They almost to the goal line but didn't want to pre-judge the outcome of the task force, but it's very clear the task force has its job ahead of it. So that undermines a little bit of

subtitles.en: that interpretation. I think the second reaction from the market is just a very clear hawkish
subtitles.zh: 我认为市场的第二反应是明显的鹰派信号。
